_readme.purpose: The self-patient family & friends offer. A patient who came on their own gets a code their family and friends can use — not them (offer 'Who can use a code' = Family & friends, not the patient).
_readme.safety: No test name, no finding, no result. Phones are shared between family members.
_readme.blanks: {{1}} first name · {{2}} the offer code · {{3}} the offer's expiry date. In the builder: First name, Offer code, Offer expiry date.
_readme.not_said: No per-bill cap and no number of uses: both are settings on the offer that may change. 'T&C apply' covers them.
_readme.no_copy_code_button: A COPY_CODE button needs the code sent as a button parameter, which the automation engine does not send — every message would be refused. The code is in the body instead, as in op_recovery_code_v1.
_readme.no_footer: No 'Reply STOP' footer, by Pranav's call. STOP still works: a reply of STOP is handled by the engine whatever the template says.
